name: Andrés Felipe Bernal Andrade
headline: Oracle Consultant || Oracle NetSuite || ERP
about:
I am a professional in Industrial Engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Javeriana with an emphasis on Fostering the Entrepreneurial Spirit and a complementary area in Industrial Design. Intermediate English. Domain in software such as NetSuite, Advanced Excel, and SPSS. I focus on good decision-making, data analysis, accompanying leadership, teamwork, and cooperation. My professional objectives are continuous learning and training in the areas of data analytics, production, logistics, and process improvement. I consider myself a proactive, analytical person, adaptable to change, good at working under pressure, and organized, with a total willingness to learn and full of energy to provide my knowledge and skills so that the company is better every day.

experiences.description:
Participate in full-cycle NetSuite implementation projects, including all project phases: Plan, Design, Build, Verify, Deploy, Support.
Participate in discovery and requirements gathering workshops.
Participate in process mapping/reengineering and future state process design.
Advise client on standard functionality, and leading practices for software and industry.
Functional system configuration design, drafting requirements, and design documents.
Collaborate with technical counterparts to deliver custom solutions to meet Client requirements.
Manage scope and requirements and work within budget/allocation at all times.
Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Systems Interface Testing (SIT) Activities.
Lead End User Training (EUT) and enablement planning activities.
Define data migration strategy and lead and/or complete all data migration activities.
Provide ongoing support to Clients post-go-live as needed.
Perform fit/gap analysis on business requirements in the route to system design and execution.

Participating in full-cycle NetSuite implementation projects from requirements gathering (inception) to post-go-live support (completion)
Participating in business process mapping and requirements gathering sessions with new customers (both remote and onsite)
Understanding customer needs and participating in gap analysis between system functionality and customer requirements
Participating in Business Requirements and Technical Scoping documentation resulting from the mapping sessions to provide proposed solutions for customer approval
Implementing and deploying NetSuite solutions following industry-specific business needs and processes, and regulatory requirements
Participating in test cases creation, test planning, and user acceptance testing session
Troubleshooting issues that arise during configuration sessions
Providing ongoing post-implementation support to optimize user adoption and NetSuite configuration
Participating in regular communication with customer SMEs (Subject Matter Experts) over the phone or in person, attending project meetings, and providing status on the progress of activities and deliverables
Acting as a trusted advisor for both clients and internal teams, and providing customers with need-based consulting and general assistance
Brand development, audiovisual content design, implementation of digital guidelines in social networks, relationship management with suppliers, and business processes.

Responsible for participating in the projects, activities, or tasks in which I am assigned to carry out the implementation of the Four Technology portfolio systems. Which include Fusion Cloud: Financial Suite, EPM applications, services, purchases, manufacturing, maintenance, projects, orders, engagement, CPQ, HCM; NetSuite: ERP Suite, SRP Suite, and NetSuite Manufacturing Suite, among others. Additionally, participate in the accounting definition and integrations with the other modules and third-party software. Complying on time, quality, and budget in accordance with the project plan, using the company's methodology, and preparing all the documentation that is required in the projects, activities, and tasks. Recommending the best business practices and achieving full customer satisfaction. Comply with the training and certification plan inherent to the specialty cycle or process.

Lead the operational processes of the production plant, complying with the demands established from the previously executed forecasts.
Analysis of historical data on sales orders to obtain a better production forecast, improving compliance indicators for all commercial channels.
Inventory control of both raw material and finished product.
Analysis of times and movements for continuous improvement in the operations of the production plant.
Management and control of production indicators OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
Leader in the control of packaging material for the company's products.

The direction of the activities of production operators, through Gantt diagrams established by a study of times and movements.
Management of production processes of new references
The leadership of the relationship with suppliers in issues of inputs and raw materials.
Design approval for packaging materials for products.
